{{EventEnd|date = 9th of November 2019}} {{For|[[Halloween 2020 Event]]}} {{EventInfobox |title1 = Halloween 2019 Event |image1 = EHNzIecXkAAdi79.jpg |dates = 18 October 2019 – 9 November 2019 |part_of = Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:Developer Events|Developer Events]] |previous_event = [[Area 51 Event|Area 51]] |next_event = [[Christmas 2019 Event|Christmas 2019]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Halloween 2019 Event''' was the third event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. The event tower, the [[Slasher|Shredder]] (later renamed to the [[Slasher]]), was awarded after players triumphed [[Nightmare Carnival]]. This event had exclusive new enemies and a new CRATE that you could purchase for a limited time. It was a Roblox-sponsored event as it was part of [[w:c:roblox:Developer Events|Developer Events]] (or ''This Week on ROBLOX''). The event started on the 18th of October 2019 (one week after the conclusion of the [[SFOTH Event]] and [[Area 51 Event]]) and ended on the 9th of November 2019. ==Maps== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Nightmare Carnival.png|200px|link=Nightmare Carnival]] |- |[[Nightmare Carnival]] |} ==Towers== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Shredder.png|200px|link=Shredder]] |- |[[Slasher|Shredder]] |} ==Crates== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Halloween Crate.png|200px|link=Halloween 2019 Crate]] |- |[[Halloween 2019 Crate]] |} ==Enemies== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Mummy.png|125px|link=Mummy (Nightmare Carnival)]] |[[File:StrongMummy.png|125px|link=Strong Mummy]] |[[File:Scarecrow.png|125px|link=Scarecrow (Nightmare Carnival)]] |[[File:Demon.png|125px|link=Demon (Nightmare Carnival)]] |[[File:Ghost.png|125px|link=Ghost (Nightmare Carnival)|class=image-shadow-light]] |[[File:Vampire.png|125px|link=Vampire (Nightmare Carnival)]] |- |[[Mummy (Nightmare Carnival)|Mummy]]
